selection_note: Selected 2026-10-18, before any model output on this set. Not frozen: the manifest freezes at the code freeze. 115 documents: 4 development pilots (one per kind) and 111 held-out. Every eligible approved download is a member; there is no subsample. The development pilot of each kind is the lowest ID whose source family has one member. Non-members and their reasons are in source_checks.json. Selection used publisher metadata, notices and layout eligibility, never a requested value or model output.
label_method: Source-only agent annotations from original PDFs, checked against original page renders. Two blind passes label every slot. An independent check of the original PDF decides each disagreement. Each absence has a second blind check. No benchmark model call has run on this set.
source_use: Each member is cited by its public URL and SHA-256. Original PDFs, page images and reader text stay private in local work storage and are not redistributed. Sources with an express reproduction or use restriction in their own notices are on hold and are not members. Terms group B members allow only personal, noncommercial or internal use: they are members only for local, internal measurement. Limited terms and attribution conditions stay recorded on each member; no broader right is inferred.

operating_temperature_max.description: Upper operating temperature limit, not storage temperature.

operating_temperature_min.description: Lower operating temperature limit, not storage temperature.

supply_current_typ.description: Typical supply current at the document reference condition. Distinguish operating modes; do not choose between equally applicable conditions.

supply_voltage_max.description: Maximum recommended supply voltage at the same stated reference condition, not an absolute maximum rating.

supply_voltage_min.description: Minimum recommended supply voltage at the stated reference condition, not an absolute maximum rating.

deductible_family.description: In-network family deductible in the plan coverage year.

deductible_individual.description: In-network deductible for one person in the plan coverage year.

out_of_pocket_family.description: In-network out-of-pocket limit for a family in the plan coverage year.

out_of_pocket_individual.description: In-network out-of-pocket limit for one person in the plan coverage year.

specialist_copay.description: In-network specialist office visit copay in USD. A percentage is not a dollar copay; unresolved conditions are unclear.

cost_of_sales.description: Latest consolidated full-year cost of sales, positive amount. Do not substitute operating expenses.

gross_profit.description: Latest consolidated full-year gross profit as stated, preserving sign. Do not compute an unstated value.

revenue.description: Latest consolidated full-year revenue, in the reporting currency after its printed scale.

total_assets.description: Latest consolidated full-year closing total assets.

total_equity.description: Latest consolidated full-year closing total equity, preserving sign.

total_liabilities.description: Latest consolidated full-year closing total liabilities, preserving the printed sign.

flash_point.description: Flash point of the product as Section 9 states it, in degrees Celsius. A bound, a range or a value only in Fahrenheit is not one value.

aliases: Initial boiling point and boiling range
initial_boiling_point.description: Initial boiling point of the product as Section 9 states it, in degrees Celsius. A bound, a range or a value only in Fahrenheit is not one value.

ph.description: pH of the product as Section 9 states it, with no unit. A range is not one value.

relative_density.description: Relative density (water = 1) as Section 9 states it, with no unit. A density with a unit is a different quantity.

un_number.description: UN number of the product as Section 14 states it, written UN and four digits.
